name: hdbt_subtheme
description: Theme builder configuration for HDBT subtheme
author: Druid
@comment scripts: Every build, lint and format script below runs inside a disposable Node container via the hdbt sandbox script.

scripts.build: ../../contrib/hdbt/tools/sandbox.sh sh -c 'npm run format:js && npm run lint && node theme-builder.mjs'
scripts.lint:scss: ../../contrib/hdbt/tools/sandbox.sh sh -c 'postcss "src/scss/**/*.scss" --syntax postcss-scss --use css-declaration-sorter --replace --no-map && npm run lint:stylelint'
